name: The Ritz-Carlton, New Orleans
positioning: Beaux Arts hotel in the historic Maison Blanche building on Canal Street, at the edge of the French Quarter
best_for: Travelers who want a base at the edge of the French Quarter
Guests who enjoy live jazz and afternoon tea
Couples looking for a spa stay

facts.text: The hotel is set within the Beaux Arts Maison Blanche building, which was originally home to the Maison Blanche Department Store.
The hotel is at 921 Canal Street, on the edge of the French Quarter, a block from Bourbon Street and Saenger Theatre.
The hotel takes up an entire city block on the edge of the French Quarter.
The Residence is a two-bedroom penthouse suite with a dining room and fully equipped kitchen, four fireplaces and a private rooftop terrace with views of the French Quarter.
Guest rooms feature commissioned artwork inspired by the city's heritage.
The Ritz-Carlton Spa covers 25,000 square feet and has 20 treatment rooms, a café and a boutique.
Signature spa treatments include a New Orleans-inspired Voodoo Ritual and a couples experience in a specially designed Couples Suite.
M Bistro serves farm-to-table Louisiana cuisine, and Davenport Lounge offers cocktails and light fare with live jazz.
Afternoon tea is served at Davenport Lounge on Saturdays and Sundays, and reservations are required.
Private dining includes three booths named Stella, Desire and Blanche, and a wine room table that seats up to twelve.
The Michelin Guide named The Ritz-Carlton, New Orleans among fourteen hotels in its New Orleans MICHELIN Selected Stays.

highlights.text: The Residence is a two-bedroom penthouse suite with four fireplaces and a private rooftop terrace with views of the French Quarter.
A gumbo masterclass lets guests learn to make a Louisiana gumbo, from the roux to the finished dish, guided by the hotel's chef.
Jeremy Davenport and his band play live jazz at Davenport Lounge.
The spa covers 25,000 square feet with 20 treatment rooms, and offers a New Orleans-inspired Voodoo Ritual.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
Valet parking is offered at the hotel for a daily fee.
